findings.minimal_fix: Emit one parseable terminal JSON receipt with status/stage/code and bounded fields; remove key=value lines.
findings.reason: All success and stop paths emit key=value via KV2/KVL/printf, not the required JSON receipt. Evidenced by source macros and ROOT receipt_format; consequence is unparsable status adjudication.

findings.minimal_fix: Map NOT_CHECKED to exit 2, FAIL1/PAYLOAD_EXPERIMENT_ONLY to 1/0 per spec; keep status enum distinct from exit.
findings.reason: stop always exit(1) even for NOT_CHECKED, conflating unavailable prerequisite with attempted failure. ROOT exit_classification confirmed; spec requires NOT_CHECKED exit 2.

findings.minimal_fix: Check every destroy/free/close return, propagate first error, set cleanup_unknown=true on any failure or timeout-busy path.
findings.reason: cleanup ignores all release/close results yet receipts declare cleanup_unknown=false. No verified quiescence after fence timeout; claimed certainty is unevidenced.

findings.minimal_fix: Call pinned CUDA 13.4 four-arg cuCtxCreate_v4(context, params, flags, device) exactly; do not substitute legacy 3-arg header.
findings.reason: Measured COMPILE_FAILED: too few arguments vs pinned cuda.h:6648 cuCtxCreate_v4(CUcontext*,CUctxCreateParams*,unsigned int,CUdevice). Supersedes prior PENDING adjudication.

findings.minimal_fix: Read pinned ze_api.h memoryAllocationImportTypes/memoryAllocationExportTypes/imageImportTypes/imageExportTypes for DMA-BUF support.
findings.reason: Measured error: ze_device_external_memory_properties_t has no member memoryImportSupported per pinned ze_api.h:2738-2748. Capability gate cannot evaluate as written.

findings.minimal_fix: Set ifd.flags=ZE_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_TYPE_FLAG_DMA_BUF with correct stype/pNext/fd per pinned descriptor.
findings.reason: Measured error: ze_external_memory_import_fd_t has no member type per pinned ze_api.h:8080-8088; actual members are stype/pNext/flags/fd. Import cannot compile.
Measured errors: ZE_COMMAND_QUEUE_GROUP_COPY_BIT and _COMPUTE_BIT undeclared; pinned names are PROPERTY_FLAG variants. Queue selection cannot compile.
Measured errors: too few arguments and void** to size_t conversion vs pinned ze_api.h:7619-7627. Same call-site defect, not runtime support evidence.
Measured error: cannot convert ze_device_handle_t to ze_context_handle_t vs pinned ze_api.h:3983-3988. Context argument omitted.
Measured error: device passed as context vs pinned ze_api.h:3588-3593 requiring context first. Same omission class as command-list defect.
Measured error: cannot convert event-pool handle to device-handle array vs pinned ze_api.h:5507-5517. Device-count/array arguments mishandled.

findings.minimal_fix: Retain/close only application-owned FD at documented transfer point; if ownership unspecified, leave open/mark unknown and do not set -1 as consumed proof.
findings.reason: Success path assumes importer consumes app duplicate by setting import_fd=-1 without primary proof; failure path closes. Lifetime/double-close semantics unverified against pinned FD contract.

findings.minimal_fix: Resolve CUDA UUID, Intel root UUID, DMA_BUF_SUPPORTED, and L0 import caps before cuMemAlloc/export where possible; else honest NOT_CHECKED without side effects.
findings.reason: CUDA context/alloc/export precede Intel eligibility and DMA_BUF gates, so unsupported current WSL path allocates before known prerequisites. Ordering defect, not global impossibility proof.

findings.minimal_fix: Bound enumeration, surface query errors as NOT_CHECKED, validate root/device type and zeMemGetAllocProperties owner equals intended Intel root.
findings.reason: Enumeration unbounded with silent skip of query errors; PCI/domain reads ignore returns; root GPU type and imported allocation owner handle not validated to intended physical device.

findings.minimal_fix: On fence/event timeout report cleanup_unknown=true and avoid destroying potentially busy list/queue/allocations, or add verified quiescence before destroy.
findings.reason: 10s fence timeout plus outer 30s alarm routes through cleanup that destroys list/queue/imports without verified quiescence; may destroy busy work and misreport as drained.
